GlobalConfig._comment_Path: Absolute path to a JSON file, outside the repo and never committed, holding this environment's actual ConnectionStrings:WishlistDb/Mongo:ConnectionString/Redis:ConnectionString values (kart-conventions.md Configuration Management). Program.cs layers it on top of this file at startup and fails fast if the path is unset or missing. Local dev sets the concrete path in appsettings.Local.json; a deployed environment supplies it via the GlobalConfig__Path env var pointing at a mounted secret file.

ConnectionStrings._comment_WishlistDb: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed.

Mongo._comment: DatabaseName/CollectionName are non-secret operational settings and stay here. ConnectionString points at the mongos router of the sharded cluster in production (scripts/init-mongo-cluster.sh).
Mongo._comment_ConnectionString: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed.

Redis._comment_ConnectionString: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed.

Jwt._comment: Issuer/JwksUri point at kart-identity-service in every real environment.

Otlp._comment: Set via Observability__Otlp__Endpoint env var to enable OTLP export; empty = console-only Serilog + Prometheus scrape, no OTLP exporter.
